name: Atlantis: Lost Civilization Artifacts
description: Comprehensive catalog of mythological artifacts from the lost city of Atlantis, focusing on the Bronze Age period (circa 9600 BCE) and connections to ancient Mediterranean cultures.

name: Lemuria: The Sunken Motherland
description: Catalog of artifacts attributed to Lemuria (also called Mu), a hypothesized lost continent and civilization theorized by 19th-century naturalists and later popularized by occultist writers as an advanced antediluvian culture submerged beneath the Indian or Pacific Ocean.

name: El Dorado: City of Gold
description: Catalog of artifacts associated with El Dorado, the legendary golden city (and, in its earliest form, a golden man — the "gilded one") of South American lore, tied to the Muisca tribal ritual at Lake Guatavita and later inflated by Spanish conquistadors into a search for a lost city of gold.

name: Shambhala: The Hidden Kingdom
description: Catalog of artifacts attributed to Shambhala, the hidden kingdom of Tibetan Buddhist mythology described in the Kalachakra Tantra as a paradise of enlightened rulers concealed beyond the Himalayas, blending spiritual cosmology with legendary geography.

name: Thule: The Northern Edge of the World
description: Catalog of artifacts attributed to Thule, the far-northern land described by the Greek explorer Pytheas in the 4th century BCE and later mythologized as Hyperborea/Ultima Thule, a legendary civilization at the edge of the known world associated with the Arctic and sub-Arctic North Atlantic.
